此端不支持机密字段 {field}。: This side doesn’t support the secret field {field}.
CA 字段不能包含私钥，原文件已保留。: CA fields can’t contain a private key. The original file was kept.
Connector 入站固定为仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 sing-box: The Connector inbound is fixed to sing-box SOCKS listening on 127.0.0.1 only (tag socks).
Connector 出站固定为 sing-box VLESS（tag relay: The Connector outbound is fixed to sing-box VLESS (tag relay).
Connector 管理页仅允许回环或家庭局域网监听。: The Connector manager may only listen on loopback or the home LAN.
Connector 管理页只允许家庭局域网访问。: The Connector manager is only reachable from the home LAN.
ID 仅支持字母、数字、短横线、下划线。: IDs may only contain letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
Relay 入站固定为 sing-box VLESS（tag proxy）。: The Relay inbound is fixed to sing-box VLESS (tag proxy).
Relay 或公网管理必须开启 HTTPS。: Relay or public management requires HTTPS.
SOCKS 与管理监听端口冲突。: The SOCKS port conflicts with the manager port.
TLS 文件不存在或超出受控目录。: The TLS file doesn’t exist or is outside the managed folder.
TLS 文件数量已达上限，请在本机整理旧资产。: The TLS file limit has been reached. Clean up old files on this machine.
TLS 文件格式无效，私钥须为未加密 PEM。: Invalid TLS file. Private keys must be unencrypted PEM.
frpc.serverAddr 固定为 127.0.0.1（经 sing-box: frpc.serverAddr is fixed to 127.0.0.1 (reaching frps on Relay’s loopback through sing-box).
frps.allowPorts 不能包含 inbound、bindPort 或管: frps.allowPorts can’t include the inbound, bindPort or manager port.
frps.allowPorts 的 start 不能大于 end。: In frps.allowPorts, start can’t be greater than end.
inbound 与管理监听端口冲突。: The inbound port conflicts with the manager port.
inbound.listen 须为明确的 IP。: inbound.listen must be a specific IP.
inbound、frps.bindPort 与管理监听端口冲突。: The inbound, frps.bindPort and manager ports conflict.
outbound.tls.certificate 须为空或 PEM 证书。: outbound.tls.certificate must be empty or a PEM certificate.
proxy name 或 remotePort 重复，或与 frpc.serve: Duplicate proxy name or remotePort, or a conflict with frpc.serverPort.
proxy 不能指向本机管理或 SOCKS 端口。: A proxy can’t point to the local manager or SOCKS port.
route rule 只能放行 frps.bindPort 或 frps.all: Route rules may only allow frps.bindPort or ports in frps.allowPorts.
route rule 引用了不存在的 user。: A route rule refers to a user that doesn’t exist.
route rule 的 auth_user 无效。: Invalid auth_user in a route rule.
route rule 的 port 无效。: Invalid port in a route rule.
route rule 的 port_range 无效。: Invalid port_range in a route rule.
route rule 须包含 port 或 port_range。: A route rule needs port or port_range.
仅 Connector 支持平台连接。: Only the Connector supports platform connections.
会话校验失败，请重新登录。: Session check failed. Please sign in again.
修订元数据损坏，已保留原文件。: The revision metadata is corrupted. The original file was kept.
公网 TLS 入口仅用于 Relay。: The public TLS entry is only for Relay.
公网入口与 inbound、管理、frps 监听冲突。: The public entry conflicts with the inbound, manager or frps listener.
公网入口端口须与 inbound.listen_port 一致。: The public entry port must match inbound.listen_port.
公网入口须为本机明确的非回环 IP。: The public entry must be a specific non-loopback IP on this machine.
凭据错误或初始化凭据已过期。: Wrong credential, or the bootstrap token has expired.
原文件已另存保留，备份已恢复为新修订，尚未应用。: The original file was kept aside and the backup restored as a new revision. It isn’t applied yet.
启用公网入口前必须先设置管理员密码。: Set an admin password before enabling the public entry.
启用公网入口时管理页必须开启 HTTPS。: The manager must use HTTPS when the public entry is enabled.
启用公网入口时，inbound.listen 须为回环地址。: With the public entry enabled, inbound.listen must be a loopback address.
局域网直连选项仅用于 Connector。: The LAN direct option is only for the Connector.
平台模式请通过服务列表管理映射。: In platform mode, manage mappings through the service list.
当前只支持 tcp 类型的 proxy。: Only tcp proxies are supported for now.
待恢复文件已变化，请重新检查。: The file to recover has changed. Check again.
操作失败，请检查配置和服务权限；原文件未被默认值覆盖。: The action failed. Check the configuration and service permissions; the original file was not overwritten with defaults.
操作失败；请检查本机组件状态。机密未写入日志。: The action failed. Check the local components; no secrets were logged.
旧配置已保存为新修订，尚未应用。: The previous configuration was saved as a new revision. It isn’t applied yet.
普通配置只能保存机密引用，原文件已保留。: Plain configuration may only hold secret references. The original file was kept.
每个 user 必须使用不同的 UUID。: Each user needs a different UUID.
登录尝试过多，请稍后重试。: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
管理 HTTPS 证书不可用。: The manager HTTPS certificate isn’t usable.
管理入口变化需要先保存，再在本机重启管理服务后应用。当前运行修订保持不变。: Management entry changes must be saved, then applied after restarting the manager on this machine. The running revision is unchanged.
管理员密码已设置，所有会话已退出。请重新登录。: Admin password set and all sessions signed out. Please sign in again.
管理员密码须为 16–256 个字符。: The admin password must be 16–256 characters.
管理监听地址须为明确的 IP。: The manager listen address must be a specific IP.
组件配置已通过；TCP 可达不等于代理认证、家庭隧道或媒体播放成功。: Component configuration passed. TCP reachability doesn’t prove proxy authentication, the home tunnel or media playback work.
组件配置校验失败；请检查证书、凭据与内置组件配置。: Component configuration check failed. Check certificates, credentials and the built-in component settings.
请先登录管理页面。: Sign in to the manager first.
请求必须是有长度的 JSON。: The request must be JSON with a length.
请求过大或为空。: The request is too large or empty.
请输入 IP 或主机名，不包含 URL、路径或凭据。: Enter an IP or host name without a URL, path or credentials.
请选择 PEM 证书或未加密私钥，最多 128 KiB。: Choose a PEM certificate or unencrypted private key, at most 128 KiB.
运行状态文件损坏，原文件已保留。: The runtime state file is corrupted. The original file was kept.
配置字段缺失或包含未知字段。: Configuration fields are missing or unknown.
配置已保存但未生效；已尝试恢复上一份运行配置。: Saved but not in effect; the previous running configuration was restored.
配置已修改，未应用其他修订。: The configuration changed; no other revision was applied.
配置已修改，请重新加载后编辑。: The configuration changed. Reload before editing.
配置文件损坏或不可读，原文件已保留。: The configuration file is corrupted or unreadable. The original file was kept.
配置版本不支持，禁止覆盖原文件。: Unsupported configuration version; the original file won’t be overwritten.
非回环管理必须先设置管理员密码。: Set an admin password before managing beyond loopback.
